title: ICE Is Paying AT&T to Dig Through a Mountain of Call Records
excerpt: An internal ICE document obtained by 404 Media shows ICE is paying AT&T for access to “raw data and analytical services.” Experts and lawmakers call it a mass surveillance program that may impact trillions of records.
